title: focuser_primaluce calibration START failed on a SESTO SENSO 3 because its CAL_DIR write restarts the controller
summary: The SESTO SENSO 2 sequence writes CAL_DIR between Init and StoreAsMinPos; firmware 1.0.9 restarts after every CAL_DIR write, so the next steps went unanswered and the calibration failed.

resolution.evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: the SESTO SENSO 3 sequence sets CAL_DIR first and only when it changes, waits for the restart, then Init/StoreAsMinPos/GoOutToFindMaxPos, and END sends StopMotor; sestosenso3_calibration(_restart) pass; hardware calibrations in both directions.
